notes.title: Thank You for A Great My Lovely Empress Release Day!
notes.notes:
May a thousand years of glory and praise rain upon your name, Your Majesty! 

In case you missed it my liege, My Lovely Empress is out now! 

We want thank everyone who took part in giving us such an amazing launch day. We're overjoyed that so many of you joined us in sowing death and destruction upon Ashuwa 🔥

We also want to say another huge thank you for 95% positive reviews! If you haven't yet, here's a reminder to leave a review of your own, it really helps for the visibility of indie games like ours! 🖤

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615942/6f0b685f66a21aed33ff650fe4a02a44884b67eb.png

Finally, we are aware that there are currently some issues with the artbook for My Lovely Empress. We are currently working with Steam to fix this, and hopefully we'll be able to get the artbook into your libraries as soon as possible! 😄 

The Crimson Empire's glory is but a mirror of your own, Your Majesty. May your rule stretch to all of the continent, and your reign outlive humanity itself!

~ Neon Doctrine and GameChanger 👑

notes.title: For Existing Players Not Getting the ReBorn Update.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

We have received some reports of the My Lovely Daughter: ReBorn DLC not automatically being added to the accounts of existing players. 

If you are experiencing this, you might need to tick the DLC in the games properties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31818974/67552a2c479fb65c337af4b1684ddee23cc69a69.png

If the DLC is not there, then please send us a screenshot of your My Lovely Daughter Steam license so we can provide you with a key. 

The best way to contact us is to Direct Message our community manager Neon Lucy, who can be found via the Neon Doctrine Discord server: https://discord.gg/nd

How to check your steam license: 
[olist]
 press windows+R
 type in steam://open/console and press enter

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31818974/0af5287b33b006255cf7698417746160edd1b753.png
 [On Steam Console] type in: licenses_for_app 580170 and press enter

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31818974/c930cfa728d083b7c09c9b2e3d950003667c5340.png
[/olist]
Send us a screenshot like the one above with your SteamID visible to verify you have not received the DLC. 

We hope those of you who have received the update are enjoying the upgraded artwork, and hopefully the rest of you will be enjoying them shortly! 

~ Neon Doctrine 🤍

notes.title: Free "Sacrificial Sons Update" is now Live!
notes.notes:
Return to the shoes of Faust, an amnesiac alchemist and a father who wakes up to find their daughter having passed away. His soul gripped by the madness that can only come from grief, he embarks on a quest to rebuild her... by creating homunculi daughters, bonding with them, then murdering them to harvest their souls. 
[previewyoutube=TPdS-Pt6Gn0;full][/previewyoutube]
But the destructive path you walk on will no longer just be paved with the corpses of little girls. With the Sacrificial Sons update, you can now create homunculi sons to keep you company, do your bidding, and ultimately die for you just like the girls have. Once more you’ll have to answer: What are you willing to do to get your daughter back? 

Did we mention a 65% discount as well?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/580170/My_Lovely_Daughter/

notes.title: New Homunculus Interactions, Controller Support, and a Teaser for Future Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31818974/5d972b869b5cdbf0cccbf133262304d86f1fb0a0.png
Hello, our lovely friends!

Thank you for your feedback for the controller support - beta version of My Lovely Daughter. The feature is now available along with other additional small improvements on the latest version of the game (Ver. 1.06). Here’s the complete list of changes:


 Added controller support (Xinput: e.g. Xbox One or Xbox 360 joystick)
 Added Homunculus interactions when Faust spends time with them.
 Our composer has fine-tuned most of the BGM and SFX.
 Added new expressions to villagers.


We are now moving on to work on a bigger and story-filled update for the game. Here’s a small teaser for a new character that will be visiting the Salach village soon in the update. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31818974/8b4e9a517924e1f0019f17c6c401ffc5a9e31f00.jpg

See you all on the next announcement! For more discussion, you can visit the Steam forum discussion or join our Discord channel at https://discord.gg/toge

notes.title: Beta access for controller support update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31818974/23fc31dd2521591639e778e9846e8c27283bb713.png

Hello, our lovely players!

We are currently working on adding controller support for My Lovely Daughter and fine-tuning some aspects of the game. We have just opened an access to the beta build of My Lovely Daughter so that you can try out the update before we push it to the public main branch. 

Current beta update:

Added controller support (Xinput: e.g. Xbox One or Xbox 360 joystick)
Our composer has fine-tuned most of the BGM and SFX
Added new villagers art, their expression will respond accordingly based on request results


You can try out the beta build by right-clicking the My Lovely Daughter application in your Steam Library. Left-click Properties, then choose the "Betas" tab. Choose "public-beta" from the drop-down menu then close the window.

We are still working on some other new features, and will update the beta build accordingly and inform you if something new is implemented. Join further discussions of the update and the whole game in general by visiting the Steam forum or join our Discord channel.
